pintasan.ringkas: These shortcuts work on every page. On a Mac, use ⌘ instead of Ctrl.
pintasan: Search pages, dashboards, charts, datasets, or commands
Open / close the AI Assistant panel
How to use the current page

umum.ringkas: The menu on the left follows the order in which a report is built: Data, Query, Visual, then Dashboards & Stories. The small numbers next to menu items are the step order.
langkah: Pick a menu item on the left, or press Ctrl + K and type a page name.
Press ? at any time to open the guide for the current page.
Click ✦ in the top bar (Ctrl + I) for the AI Assistant. Pick a role: /analis, /panduan, /data-engineer, /ahli-ui-ux, /hw-engineer.
Hover over a table or chart on an ALDx page and click Export (top right): Image, PDF, Excel, CSV, Text, or Copy table.

beranda.ringkas: Your starting point: search anything, follow the report-building steps, and pick up where you left off.
langkah: Type in the search box: a dashboard, chart, or dataset name. When the AI Assistant is active, click Ask AI to ask in plain language.
Follow the 5 Build a report cards from the left: Connect data, Prepare data, Create a chart, Build a dashboard, Tell it with a story.
The card marked Next step is a step you have not done yet.
Continue where you left off lists the charts & dashboards you opened most recently.
tips: Star a dashboard (in Dashboards) so it always appears at the top of Home.

hubungkan.ringkas: Connect a database, data warehouse, or file (Excel, CSV, Access) in 4 steps. Admins only.
langkah: Choose the source type.
Fill in the address, database name, user, and password (ask your DBA for a read-only account).
Click Test connection; fix anything shown in red.
Click Save. The source appears right away in Datasets, Visual Query, and SQL Lab.
tips: Connections are always read-only and passwords are stored encrypted.
An Excel file with several sheets becomes several datasets at once.

dataset.ringkas: A dataset is a table or query ready to be charted. Data access rules (RLS) are attached here.
langkah: Click + Dataset to pick a table from a connection, or create one from Visual Query / Data prep.
Click a dataset name to start a chart straight away.
Pencil icon: edit columns, number formats, and metrics.
tips: Columns named lat/lon, province, or city are recognised automatically as map columns.

prep.ringkas: Clean and shape data without SQL.
langkah: Choose the Source data.
Click Actions on a column card or Add step: filter, rename, change type, calculate a new column, join tables, summarise.
Check the column profile & preview below.
Enter a name, then Save as dataset.
tips: Click any step to edit or delete it; steps run from left to right.
Hover over a table or chart on an ALDx page and click Export (top right): Image, PDF, Excel, CSV, Text, or Copy table.

ekstrak.ringkas: Copy a dataset into the ALDx Engine so dashboards are much faster and the source database is not burdened. Admins only.
langkah: Choose the Source dataset (datasets with template filters cannot be extracted).
Choose a mode: Full (replace everything) or Incremental (append new rows).
Set the schedule, then click Create & refresh now.
tips: Data access rules (RLS) are copied to the extract dataset too.

kueri.ringkas: Build a query by clicking, without typing SQL. Requires the Analyst role.
langkah: Choose a database and schema; only that schema's tables are shown.
Double-click a table: the query is built and run immediately.
Double-click a second table: it is joined automatically through a matching column.
Tick columns, choose a summary (Sum, Average…), add filters & sorting.
Save as dataset, then continue in Visual Studio.
tips: If the row count jumps after a join, the join column is probably wrong; check the Join box.
Hover over a table or chart on an ALDx page and click Export (top right): Image, PDF, Excel, CSV, Text, or Copy table.

sqllab.ringkas: SQL editor for advanced users. Results can be saved as a dataset or downloaded.
langkah: Choose the database & schema on the left.
Type SQL, then run it.
Click Save dataset to use the results in a chart.
pintasan: Run the statement at the cursor
tips: Not used to SQL? Use Visual Query.

tersimpan.ringkas: The SQL queries you saved from SQL Lab.
langkah: Click a query name to reopen it in SQL Lab.
Use the search box to find older queries.

studio.ringkas: Build charts by drag and drop, then lay out a dashboard.
langkah: Choose a Data source.
Drag Dimensions (by what?) to the Columns shelf and Measures (how much?) to the Rows shelf.
Pick a type under Show me; a gold frame = recommended.
Add Color, Filters, Forecast if needed, then Save.
Build a dashboard tab: drag worksheets onto the canvas, add filters, Save.
pintasan: Add it to a shelf automatically
tips: Drag a pill off its shelf to remove it.
Hover over a table or chart on an ALDx page and click Export (top right): Image, PDF, Excel, CSV, Text, or Copy table.

chart.ringkas: Every chart you are allowed to see. Click a name to open & edit it.
langkah: Filter by name, type, owner, or dataset.
Click the star to mark a favourite.
Click a chart name to open the editor (Explore).

explore.ringkas: The built-in chart editor: choose a type, metrics, dimensions, filters, then save.
langkah: Change the chart type at the top left.
Set Metrics, Dimensions, Filters, then click Update chart.
Save: save it and add it to a dashboard.
tips: The ⋯ menu at the top right: download CSV/Excel/image, copy a link, view the query.

dashboard.ringkas: Every dashboard you are allowed to see.
langkah: Click a name to open the dashboard.
Click the star to favourite it (it then appears on Home).
+ Dashboard creates an empty dashboard; the fastest way is the Build a dashboard tab in Visual Studio.

lihat-dashboard.ringkas: Filter in the left panel; every chart follows.
langkah: Open the filter panel on the left, choose values, click Apply filters.
Click part of a chart (e.g. one bar) to filter the other charts (cross-filter).
Hover over a chart and click ⋯ for full screen, view data, or download.
tips: The ⋯ button at the top right of the dashboard: download PDF/image, share a link, schedule an email.

story.ringkas: A story is a presentation scenario that chains several dashboards in order, with narration.
langkah: Click New story and enter a title & description.
Add dashboards; reorder them with Up/Down.
Write narration for each step (or Write narration with AI when available).
Save, then open it to present; move between steps with the arrow buttons.
tips: Tick Public so other users with access to its dashboards can view the story.

asisten.ringkas: Ask about your data in plain language, or create charts & dashboards automatically.
langkah: Ask AI: type a question, e.g. What are sales by branch this year?
Auto Chart: choose a dataset, click Analyse dataset, tick suggestions, then Create.
tips: The AI always queries data as you, so your data access rules still apply.

pusat.ringkas: Server status, identity & theme, connections & extracts (Admin). Settings, Data limits & Permissions are Superadmin only.
langkah: Status: monitor CPU, RAM, cache, and processes.
Settings (Superadmin): change limits & capacity; items labelled Needs apply take effect after scripts\terapkan-server.ps1.
Data limits (Superadmin): see recommendations from RAM & disk, then choose Use recommendation, auto, or No limit.
Identity & Theme: name, logo, colors, motion (applies immediately).
Permissions (Superadmin): capabilities per role.
tips: Open the AI Assistant (Ctrl + I) with the /hw-engineer or /ahli-ui-ux role for settings & theme proposals; changes only apply after you press Apply.

langkah: + for a new account: username, name, email, password, roles (Gamma + Pengguna; add sql_lab for analysts).
Deactivate unused accounts instead of deleting them, so history stays intact.

role.ringkas: Groups of permissions. Branch roles are used by data access rules (RLS).
langkah: Create a role per data group (e.g. Bandung Branch).
Set role capabilities in Control Center > Permissions.

rls.ringkas: Rules for which rows each role may see.
langkah: + new rule: choose the dataset, role, and clause, e.g. kd_cabang = 'C02'.
Test with two different accounts; Admins always see all data.

koneksi.ringkas: Superset's built-in connection list for advanced settings. For new connections use Data > Connect data.

riwayat.ringkas: Every query run in SQL Lab, for auditing and troubleshooting.

log.ringkas: A record of user actions (open, edit, download).

berkas.ringkas: Save & share dashboards, charts, or datasets as encrypted files.
langkah: Export: choose a type, tick objects, choose .ald (no data) or .aldx (may carry a data copy), choose a key, then Download file.
Server key = opens only on this ALDx server. Password = opens on any ALDx server with that password.
Import: choose a file, enter the password if asked, check the summary, choose target connections (or Use data in file), then Import.
New copy leaves existing objects untouched. Overwrite updates the same dashboard/chart.
tips: Files never carry server addresses or connection passwords.
Data in .aldx holds only rows the file creator may see. Set access rights on imported datasets before sharing.

moderasi.ringkas: Approve or reject comments & ratings before others see them. Superadmin only.
langkah: The Pending tab lists new comments.
Show = visible to everyone who may open that dashboard/chart.
Reject = enter a reason (seen by the author), then Reject.
tips: Moderation can be turned off in Control Center › Settings › Comments need Superadmin approval.
